\medskip
\noindent{\displayfont\itshape\large Joan Northcutt Lankford}\par
\nopagebreak{\eyebrow{The recipient (Gene's wife)}}\par
\nopagebreak\vspace{0.2em}
\nopagebreak{\small The Stanford, Kentucky girl Gene courted by mail and married on April 20, 1943. Her maiden name was Northcutt; she lived on Route 1, Stanford, and is the recipient of nearly all the letters.}\par
\smallskip
\noindent{\displayfont\itshape\large Raymond Eugene "Gene" Lankford}\par
\nopagebreak{\eyebrow{The writer}}\par
\nopagebreak\vspace{0.2em}
\nopagebreak{\small The young sailor who wrote essentially all of these letters; born 1921 in Stanford, Lincoln County, Kentucky. He served aboard the U.S.S. New Orleans (CA-32) in the F Division, courting Joan Northcutt by mail throughout the war.}\par
